title: Token Atlas lint config
description: Token lint conventions for this workspace folder. Every rule is silent until its key is set: Token Atlas ships no opinions of its own.

tiers.description: Token tiers, primitive first, e.g. ["base", "system", "component"]. A tier is a token path's first segment (before any "/mode" suffix). Aliases must point down the tiers. Fewer than two: the rule is silent.

vocabularies.description: Closed sets of leaf names. A token whose parent path matches one of an entry's paths must have a leaf in its values; the first matching entry governs.

paths.description: Parent-path patterns, e.g. "system.radius" or "*.state". `*` matches exactly one segment.

rampPaths.description: Color ramp groups, e.g. "color.neutral" or "color.*.ramp" (`*` is one segment). Ordered by numeric step, each ramp's lightness must move one way.

case.description: The case every group and token name follows. Numeric names and vocabulary values are always allowed.

contrastPairs.description: Foreground/background token pairs and the WCAG contrast each must reach. A pair is checked on resolved values, in the file that defines its foreground, under the active token set.

foreground.description: The text or icon color's token path, e.g. "color.text.default". Findings appear on its definition; a foreground no file defines is reported on the background's.

background.description: The surface color's token path, e.g. "color.surface.default".

rules.description: Severity per rule. A rule whose config is set but which is not listed here runs at "warn".

contrastTarget.description: A WCAG threshold: AA (4.5:1), AA-large (3:1), AAA (7:1), AAA-large (4.5:1), non-text (3:1), or a ratio from 1 to 21. Defaults to AA.
